test_proto_serialize_parse: test the proto module by serializing and parsing a protobuf message round-trip
test_proto_length_prefixed_io: test length-prefixed serialization and parsing of protobuf messages to and from a BytesIO stream
test_proto_byte_size: test the proto byte_size function to verify serialized message size in bytes
test_proto_clear_message: test the proto clear_message function to reset all fields on a protobuf message
test_proto_clear_field: test the proto clear_field function to reset a specific field on a protobuf message
